limits: Illustrative selected cases, not a prevalence estimate or causal attribution. Single-view visibility and sparse temporal sampling limit visual labels.
method: Inspected all 26 eight-frame contact sheets (14 dev failures, 6 paired clean failures/successes); consulted saved-state goal/contact diagnostics for selected clean cases. Full MP4s exported and separately decoded for verification; no claim of human review or exhaustive frame-by-frame viewing.
